name: Oelde (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Oelde (a white star and crescent on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Oelde; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Oelde arms — star and crescent on blue
